steps.label: Quellkarten ergaenzen
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && for f in tp/bundle/*.js; do [ -f "$f.map" ] || echo '{"version":3,"sources":[],"names":[],"mappings":""}' > "$f.map"; done; ls tp/bundle/*.map | wc -l

steps.label: Video rendern
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion render tp/bundle P tp_out1.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error

steps.label: Ton und Vorschau
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i tp_out1.mp4 -i tp/mix.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest tp_film1.mp4 && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i tp_film1.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 27 -preset veryfast -vf scale=1280:-2 -c:a copy tp_film1_vorschau.mp4 && tar czf tp1v.tgz tp_film1_vorschau.mp4 && ls -l tp1v.tgz tp_film1.mp4 > tp1_done.txt
